user.title: Alexa Room Sync
user.description: Pick the Alexa account whose Alexa groups should mirror your Home Assistant areas. It uses the signed-in session of HA's Alexa Devices integration if that account is set up there, otherwise Alexa Media Player's.

abort.no_alexa_media: No signed-in Alexa account found. Set up Home Assistant's Alexa Devices integration (or Alexa Media Player) first; this integration reuses its session.
abort.already_configured: This Alexa account is already set up.

menu_options.remove_rooms: Remove the Alexa groups it manages

settings.title: Alexa Room Sync settings
settings.description: Each Home Assistant area gets one Alexa group. Nothing is written to Alexa until you turn dry-run off and tick the confirmation.

data.confirmed_not_dry_run: I understand 'apply' will write to my Alexa account
data.include_child_locks: Put child-lock switches in Alexa groups
data.include_echos: Put Echos in their area's Alexa group (uses each Echo's area in Alexa Devices, or in Alexa Media Player)
data.floor_groups: Also make one Alexa group per Home Assistant floor
data.auto_sync: Sync automatically when areas, floors, devices or exposure change (needs dry-run off and the confirmation ticked)

skip.name: Areas to skip
skip.description: These areas never get an Alexa group from a whole-house sync and don't appear in One area. The sync_area action can still target one directly.

remove_rooms.title: Remove the Alexa groups it manages
remove_rooms.description: Deletes the Alexa groups this integration created or adopted. A group that also holds something you added yourself, like an Echo, is kept with just those devices. Groups you made yourself are otherwise never touched. Removing the integration on its own does not change Alexa.
